output.reason: The linked PR [ev-508cd6635da3] defines a malformed resource as one that applies to the whole cluster but has metadata.namespace set. The repo-server can't tell cluster-scoped from namespaced resources, so it may write the wrong tracking annotation, and the controller now corrects it [ev-9fdf3ef2828b]. The proposal's claim that 'malformed' is undefined is wrong. Exposure still depends on which resource types are cluster-scoped (including custom types), which only the live cluster knows, so an undecidable leaf with the PR's definition is the correct condition.

correction.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0's controller fixes the tracking annotation that the repo-server may have written wrongly on cluster-scoped resources whose manifests have metadata.namespace set. An environment is exposed only if its Applications manage such resources. That depends on which resource types are cluster-scoped, which only the live cluster knows.

exposure.needed: whether any Application manages a cluster-scoped resource whose manifest sets metadata.namespace (the PR's definition of malformed). Whether a type is cluster-scoped, including custom types, is known only from the live cluster's API discovery.
